summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TeleConnect CRM reporting enhancements. All 4 requested features are implemented and working correctly: 1) 'File' status replaces 'Interested' across the app, 2) Hourly Report shows table with Calls/Connected/Presentations/Leads/File columns, 3) Telecaller cards in Summary match Overall Performance 6-column layout, 4) Activity logs are grouped by telecaller with user name as header.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/reports/hourly returns presentations, leads, file data for each hour
Backend: /api/reports/telecallers returns file and presentations fields
Backend: /api/activity/logs returns grouped data by telecaller
Frontend: Admin Dashboard shows 'File' in Status Breakdown
Frontend: Telecaller Dashboard shows 'File' in Status Breakdown
Frontend: Reports Summary tab shows 6 columns: Total Calls, Leads, File, Presentations, Talk Time, Conversion
Frontend: Expanded telecaller card matches Overall Performance layout with 6 columns
Frontend: Hourly tab shows table with columns: Hour, Calls, Connected, Presentations, Leads, File
Frontend: Caller-wise Hourly Report shows expandable cards with same table structure
Frontend: Activity tab groups activities by telecaller with user name as header
Frontend: LeadDetail.js has 'file' in statuses array (not 'interested')
Frontend: Admin Leads.js has 'file' in statuses array (not 'interested')
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 reporting enhancements are correctly implemented
'Interested' status has been replaced with 'File' in: backend statuses endpoint, frontend constants, dashboard components, and lead management pages
Hourly report backend correctly aggregates presentations, leads, and file counts by hour
Activity logs endpoint supports grouped=true parameter for grouping by telecaller
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 reporting enhancements have been verified: 1) File status replaces Interested, 2) Hourly report has 6 columns, 3) Telecaller cards match Overall Performance layout, 4) Activity logs grouped by telecaller. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_reporting_enhancements.py cover all API endpoints. Frontend UI verified via Playwright screenshots.

file_status_replacement.details: 'File' status appears in /api/statuses, Admin Dashboard, Telecaller Dashboard, Reports Summary, and lead status dropdowns. 'Interested' has been removed.

hourly_report_columns.details: Hourly tab shows table with columns: Hour, Calls, Connected, Presentations, Leads, File. Both overall and per-telecaller breakdowns have this structure.

telecaller_card_layout.details: Expanded telecaller cards in Summary tab show 6 columns matching Overall Performance: Calls, Leads, File, Presentations, Talk Time, Conversion.

activity_logs_grouped.details: Activity tab groups activities by telecaller with user name as header and activity count. Each group shows individual activities with icons and timestamps.
